name: @gexein/wasm
description: WebAssembly modules for high-performance media processing

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts && npm run copy-to-root
scripts.build:wasm: mkdir -p compiled && npm run build:image-processor && npm run build:audio-processor && npm run create-wasm-types
scripts.build:image-processor: emcc src/cpp/image_processor.cpp -o compiled/image_processor.js -s WASM=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_resize_image","_apply_brightness","_apply_contrast","_convert_to_grayscale","_apply_blur","_process_image","_free_memory","_malloc","_free"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap","HEAPU8","HEAPF32"]' -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s EXPORT_NAME='createImageProcessor' -s SINGLE_FILE=1 -O3
scripts.build:audio-processor: emcc src/cpp/audio_processor.cpp -o compiled/audio_processor.js -s WASM=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_adjust_volume","_normalize_audio","_trim_audio","_apply_fade_in","_apply_fade_out","_change_speed","_apply_echo","_apply_reverb","_process_audio","_free_audio_memory","_malloc","_free"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap","HEAPU8","HEAPF32"]' -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s EXPORT_NAME='createAudioProcessor' -s SINGLE_FILE=1 -O3
scripts.copy-to-root: cp dist/index.js ./ && cp dist/index.d.ts ./ && cp dist/types.d.ts ./ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r dist/wrappers ./ 2>/dev/null || true

author: Digital Workshop Team
